definition: a dam built across a river.
example_en: The villagers built a dam across the river.

definition: the outermost or utmost point or part; an end; an extremity.
example: ದಾರಿಯ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: At the end of the road there was an old house.

definition: to cause to place in such and such a position, state, etc.
example_en: Mother placed the book on the table.

definition: to blame, scold or reprove with harsh words or in a sharp way; to censure; to condemn; to rebuke.
example: ತಾಯಿ ಮಗನನ್ನು ಕೆಡೆನುಡಿದಳು, ಆದರೆ ಅವನು ಕೇಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The mother scolded her son harshly, but he did not listen.

definition: to make a hole; to bore or drill.
example_en: The workers bored a hole in the wall and fitted the pipe.

definition: made of leather.
example: ಇದು ತ್ವಗ್ಜ ವಸ್ತುವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಬಹಳ ಬಾಳಿಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This is a leather-made object and lasts very long.

definition: a male off-spring; a son.
example: ಆ ಕುಮಾರ ತಂದೆಯ ಜೊತೆ ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: That son went to the field with his father.

definition: the act of cleaning; a cleansing.
example_en: We got up early in the morning to clean the house.

definition: a fence, barricade constructed using the branches or stems of thorny plants or by growing thorny bushes.
example_en: They protected the field by putting up a thorny fence around it.

definition: the small, evergreen tree Eribotrya japonica of Rosaceae family.
example_en: They have planted a loquat tree in the garden.

definition: very difficult breathing; panting hard for breath.
example_en: The patient had severe breathing difficulty and found it hard to breathe.

definition: a hint given by the wink of the eye.
example_en: She gave a wink hint, signaling to stay silent.

definition: to tremble, shake or quiver.
example_en: His hands were trembling with fear.

definition: an elephant in rut.
example_en: The elephant in rut uprooted the tree with its trunk.

definition: a disorder of vision due to a deviation from normal orientation of one or both eyes so that both cannot be directed at the same object at the same time; squint.
example_en: That girl has had a squint since childhood.

definition: on, to or towards the inside.
example_en: As it started raining, he ran towards the inside.

definition: to support; to uphold; to justify (another's proposal, action, etc.).
example_en: All the friends gathered and supported his proposal.

definition: that which is not original, genuine or is designed to deceive another or others.
example: ಆ ಒಡವೆ ಬರೀ ಠಕಾರಿ ಎಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಕರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The examiner said that the ornament was mere fake, a deception.

definition: the tree Feronia limonia ( = F. elephantum) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: They use the wood apple fruit as a medicine.

definition: to prove or declare (an argument or statement) to be false or wrong, by argument or evidence; to refute.
example_en: He refuted that accusation in the court.

definition: to think deeply and probingly.
example: ಅವರು ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗಂಟೆಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಸಮಾಳೋಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They deliberated deeply on this matter for hours.

definition: to stand against; to face in opposition.
example: ಶತ್ರು ಸೈನ್ಯ ಇದಿರುಗಟ್ಟು ನಿಂತು ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The enemy army stood in opposition and got ready for war.

definition: the act, practice or an instance of eating human flesh; cannibalism.
example: ಆ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನರಭಕ್ಷಣದ ಭಯಾನಕ ವಿವರಣೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That story contains a terrifying description of cannibalism.

definition: the obligation one owes to another for having received money from the latter.
example: ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ಹಣರುಣ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He still owed a debt of money to his friend.

definition: a kind of vulture.
example_en: The vulture was flying high in the sky.

definition: with a thumping or banging sound.
example_en: The heavy box fell to the floor with a thumping sound.

definition: a harsh, unkind look.
example_en: The teacher's harsh look troubled the student.

definition: a garland of flowers.
example_en: On the wedding day they tied a floral garland on him.

definition: (a fruit) to ripe.
example_en: The mango fruit has now ripened.

definition: the act or process of worshipping a deity; reverent honour and homage paid to a god or a sacred personage or to any object regarded as sacred.
example_en: She performs worship in the temple every day.

definition: a ball used in a game in which it is thrown from one to another to reach it to a particular point.
example_en: In the game, they threw the poyseṇḍu ball from one to another.

definition: one's spent life.
example_en: Remembering his spent life, he wept.

definition: the plant Argyreia nervosa (= A. speciosa) of Convolvulaceae family.
example_en: The kadasige creeper had spread all along the fence.

definition: accompanied by guards.
example_en: The king entered the city accompanied by guards.

definition: the putting together of parts or elements so as to form a whole; synthesis.
example_en: The scientists carried out synthesis in the laboratory.

definition: great quantity of water.
example_en: In the rainy season, the great quantity of water in the river increased.

definition: to become old.
example_en: The old books gradually became worn out.

definition: name of a language belonging to Dravidian family.
example_en: The Kurukh language belongs to the Dravidian family.

definition: a common man.
example_en: Common men should also get these rights.

definition: to strike, with or as with a whip; to lash; to whip.
example_en: The master whipped the servant cruelly.

definition: an assembly of religious law-givers.
example_en: The religious law-givers discussed dharma in the assembly.

definition: (in pl. only) unevenness; irregular surfaces.
example: ಆ ಹಲಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓರೆಪೀರ ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಅದು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೂರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That plank did not sit properly because of its unevenness.

definition: the game of gambling played with dice.
example_en: The dice gambling went on all night.

definition: the act, process or an instance of plunging into, drowning under, water.
example_en: The child was frightened by the plunge into the water.

definition: (pl.) the two worlds - mundane world and heaven.
example_en: He is an old man who knows well both this world and the next.

definition: a strong, offensive, unpleasant smell; stench; stink.
example_en: The stench of the rotten fish spread through the whole house.

definition: sound; noise.
example_en: The sound of the waterfall was heard from far away.

definition: an earring with a hanging object.
example_en: A golden earring with a hanging object glittered on her ear.

definition: the state of being a candidate for a post, position, membership etc.; candidature.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಹುದ್ದೆಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಉಮೇದುವಾರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He submitted his candidature for that post.

definition: a fem. companion, friend.
example: ಅವಳ ಅನುಚರಿ ಆಕೆಯ ಜೊತೆಗೇ ನಡೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: Her female companion walked along with her.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: The savadu tree was giving shade near the field.

definition: a sunken eye.
example_en: Due to illness his eyes became sunken.

definition: a feeling of elation or satisfaction at achievements or qualities or possessions etc. that make one proud; pride.
example_en: The pride of victory was visible on his face.

definition: the condition of being in a shabby, neglected condition; dilapidation.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆ ಅರೋಡಾಗಿ ಯಾರೂ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The old house has fallen into dilapidation, so no one lives in it.

definition: any aquatic animal.
example_en: Fish and turtles are examples of aquatic animals.

definition: to tremble - a) to shake involuntarily from cold, fear, excitement, fatigue, etc.; to shiver; b) to feel great fear or anxiety; c) to quiver, quake, totter, vibrate, etc.
example_en: His hands were trembling from the cold.

definition: the act of soaking or being soaked.
example_en: The soaking of the seeds is necessary for germination.

definition: to regain consciousness after a brief spell of fainting.
example_en: After a short while she regained consciousness.

definition: a coal that is burning strongly.
example: ಒಲೆಯೊಳಗಿನ ಕನಲ್ಗಿಡಿ ಗಾಳಿ ತಾಗಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಉರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The strongly burning coal in the hearth flared up more when the wind touched it.

definition: he who questions or inquires about; a questioner; an inquirer.
example: ಪೃಚ್ಛಕನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕನನ್ನು ಒಂದಾದ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The questioner asked the teacher one question after another.

definition: a track or way worn by footsteps; a path; a footpath.
example_en: There was a footpath to the top of the hill.

definition: an interjection used a) to say 'sufficient', 'no more quantity is required'; b) to express one's impatience or exasperation; c) to express the feeling or aspiration 'it would be sufficient if this or that happens'.
example_en: Mother scolded, saying "Enough, no more!"

definition: a long period of time.
example_en: This temple has stood here for a long period of time.

definition: to accuse; to find fault with; to blame.
example_en: He needlessly accused the neighbor of a fault.

definition: any of a large class (Insecta) of small arthropod animals characterized, in the adult state, by division of the body into head, thorax, and abdomen, three pairs of legs on the thorax, and, usu., two pairs of membranous wings, including beetles, bees, flies, wasps, and mosquitoes; an insect.
example_en: Many insects were flying around the light.

definition: the shooting of firearms, etc. esp. by policemen; firing.
example_en: During the riot, the police carried out firing.

definition: to revolve, rotate rapidly on an axis or on the circumference of a circle.
example_en: The wheel revolved rapidly and rolled away.

definition: to convey postal letters (to their respective addressees).
example_en: The postman delivers letters every day.

definition: to read or recite in a a book etc. in a natural or successive order.
example_en: The teacher recited the book in its natural order.

definition: the act of scattering or planting of seeds for growing; a sowing.
example_en: The farmer sowed the seeds in the field in the morning.

definition: boyish play or playfulness.
example_en: The children were engaged in boyish play in the ground.

definition: that which is desirable.
example_en: Peace is something desirable to everyone.

definition: any form of play or way of playing; an amusement; a recreation; a sport; a play; a game.
example_en: The children played a game on the field.

definition: the joint that connects the foot and the leg; the ankle.
example_en: She fell while playing and her ankle swelled up.

definition: a worker in bronze or brass metal.
example: ಕಂಸಾರಕನು ಹಿತ್ತಾಳೆಯ ಪಾತ್ರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಬಡಿದು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The bronze worker made brass vessels by hammering them with a hammer.

definition: a person against whom a law suit is instituted; one who opposes the plea of the plaintiff in a court of law; a defendant.
example: ಎದುರುವಾದಿ ವಕೀಲರ ಮೂಲಕ ತನ್ನ ವಾದ ಮಂಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The defendant presented his argument through his lawyer.

definition: a man interested or engrossed in.
example_en: He is a man engrossed in music.

definition: a small sword or dagger.
example_en: He had tucked a small sword into his waist.

definition: a letter written with water.
example_en: He wrote a letter with water and let it dissolve in the water.

definition: the honey-bee or black bumble-bee.
example: ಮೇಳಂಬವು ಹೂವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಜೇನು ಸೇವಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The honey-bee sat on the flower and drank nectar.

definition: to peddle the cotton-ginning machine.
example_en: The grandmother pedalled the cotton-ginning machine and separated the cotton seeds.

definition: without following any order, discipline or reason; capriciously; fancifully; whimsically; unreasonably.
example_en: The children were running about without any order.

definition: a building or a part of one, for the storage of goods, merchandise, etc.; a warehouse.
example_en: The merchant kept his goods in the warehouse.

definition: a bunch of flowers; a bouquet.
example: ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಬಂದ ಅತಿಥಿಗೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಇಂಡಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: They gave the guest who came for the wedding a beautiful bouquet of flowers.

definition: to go out or away.
example_en: He went out from the house.

definition: a raised tract of open wasteland covered with cactus plants; a cactus-heath.
example_en: The cactus-covered wasteland spread widely outside the village.

definition: (myth.) Kāma, the god of love, son of Křṣṇa.
example_en: Grandmother told the children the story of Kama, the god of love.

definition: a tyrannical, despotic king; a tyrant; a despot.
example_en: The subjects rose in revolt against the tyrannical king.

definition: the quality of being adhesive, cohesive; adhesiveness; cohesiveness.
example_en: The adhesiveness of that gum stuck to the cloth.

definition: an interjection 'lo!' 'behold!'.
example: ಅಕ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡು, ಎಂತಹ ಸುಂದರ ದೃಶ್ಯ!
example_en: Lo, look there, what a beautiful sight!

definition: the quality of being stupid, ignorant; doltishness; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone laughed at his stupidity.

definition: to make something very strong by manifolding.
example_en: The soldiers made the fort's door very strong by manifolding it.

definition: superiority in rank, position, character, achievement, etc.; elevation; greatness; celebrity; eminence.
example_en: His eminence earned everyone's respect.

definition: a punishing or being punished; chastisement; punishment.
example_en: The king imposed chastisement on him.

definition: the quality of being abnormally smaller.
example_en: The abnormal smallness of that child is visible to everyone.

definition: a carriage drawn by an ox or oxen.
example_en: The oxen brought firewood in the ox-drawn carriage.

definition: a yellowish, fatty substance with a musk-like scent, secreted by a gland near the genitals of the civet cat and used in making some perfumes; civet.
example_en: The perfume was filled with the scent of civet.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example_en: The monument's dome was built of stone.

definition: the plant Hibiscus rosa-sinensis of Malvaceae family.
example_en: The hibiscus flower had bloomed red in the garden.

definition: offensive, distateful speech.
example: ಅವನ ಹೊಲೆಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮುಖ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Hearing his offensive speech, everyone turned their faces away.

definition: fit to be asked for, sought for.
example_en: That object was identified as fit to be sought for.

definition: a binding on two or both the,sides.
example_en: The binding of the rope was tight on both sides.

definition: [prob. wrong or confused formof pasige] a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The dividing of the property took place among the brothers.

definition: (vīr.) the hymn or hymns in praise of Vīrabhadra, one of the chief attendants of Śiva.
example_en: The devotees sang the hymn in praise of Virabhadra at the temple.

definition: the planet Venus.
example_en: The planet Venus appeared bright in the evening sky.

definition: to amuse or cause pleasure excessively; to be very delightful.
example: ಆ ವಿದೂಷಕ ತನ್ನ ಮಾತುಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರನ್ನು ಅತಿರಂಜಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The jester delighted the audience excessively with his words.

definition: the ocean, the receptor of water.
example_en: The ocean receives the water of all rivers.

definition: virtue such as being compassionate, kind, having the feeling of brotherliness, not being selfish, petty, etc., as the natural course of human beings; humanity.
example_en: Compassion and friendliness are marks of humanity.

definition: a covetous, greedy man.
example: ಆ ಕಕ್ಕುಲಿತೆಕಾಱ ತನ್ನ ಲಾಭಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಬಿಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That covetous man will spare no one for his own profit.

definition: the moon.
example_en: The moon appears full today.

definition: in great number, degree or amount.
example_en: This year the crop grew in great quantity.

definition: to accept; to consent; to agree.
example_en: He agreed to his father's words.

definition: a variety of short-snouted crocodile.
example: ನದಿಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಬುಕಂಟಕ ಮೊಸಳೆ ಬಿಸಿಲು ಕಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The short-snouted crocodile was basking on the river bank.

definition: the suffering or distress caused by prolonged drought ( as lack of water, food grains, etc.).
example_en: The villagers were shaken by the suffering caused by the drought.

definition: a shirt or overcoat having sleeves covering upto elbows.
example_en: He put on a sleeved overcoat for the cold.

definition: the element, part, substance or process (in a human or other conscious being) that reasons, thinks, feels, wills, perceives, judges, etc.; the mind.
example_en: Her mind is very gentle.

definition: a person who contracts to supply certain materials or do certain work for a stipulated sum; a contractor.
example: ಆ ಕಂತ್ರಾಟದಾರ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That contractor finished the work exactly on time.

definition: a pair of large bronze cymbals.
example_en: The artist played the bronze cymbals rhythmically.

definition: eaten; chewed and swallowed.
example_en: The food left on the plate had been eaten.

definition: adorning beautifully.
example_en: Her beautifully adorning garment shone with ornaments.

definition: a cake made by stuffing with a sweet preparartion.
example_en: Mother made purana-stuffed cakes for the festival.

definition: a kind of herb .
example: ಜೆಕರ್ಮದ ಎಂಬ ಗಿಡ ಗುಡ್ಡದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The jekarmada herb grows at the foot of the hill.

definition: a toothed strip of rigid material for tidying and arranging the hair or for keeping it in place; a comb.
example_en: She combed her hair with a comb.

definition: to cover with (a cloth, veil, etc.).
example_en: He covered the table with a cloth.

definition: the quality of being greedy; greediness; avariciousness; cupidity.
example: ಅವನ ಹಪಾಪಿತನದಿಂದ ಯಾರೂ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his greediness, no one helped him.

definition: (pl.) two (rival) parties; both the parties.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಪ್ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The opinions of both parties differed on this matter.

definition: a path; a way; a road.
example_en: That path passes through the forest.

definition: to cancel; to repeal; to revoke.
example_en: The government cancelled that order.

definition: the state of being a friend; association as friends; friendship.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೈತ್ರ್ಯ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The word 'maitrya' meaning friendship is used in old texts.

definition: a building, usu. with cells, where convicted criminals are confined; a prison; a jail.
example_en: They took the thief away to the prison.

definition: (ling.) a set of phonetically similar but slightly different sounds in a language that are heard as the same sound by native speakers and are represented in phonemic transcription by the same symbol; a phoneme.
example: ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಧ್ವನಿಮಾಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವುದು ಭಾಷಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಭಾಗ.
example_en: Identifying the phonemes in Kannada is an important part of linguistics.

definition: (fig.) a natural raised part of the earth's surface, usu. rising more or less abruptly; a hill.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ವೆಟ್ಟ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small hill beside the village.

definition: either of the external openings of the nose; a nostril.
example_en: Dust got into the nostril of the nose.

definition: being in a particular condition or state (referred to earlier).
example_en: He sat silently in that very condition.

definition: happening, doing, etc. before time.
example_en: This became possible because of advance preparation.

definition: a professional fool or clown, esp. at a royal court; a jester.
example: ರಾಜನ ಆಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಱೋಡೆಗ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The jester used to make jokes every day in the king's court.

definition: any branch of science put to actual use; applied science.
example_en: Engineering is a branch of applied science.

definition: an interjection expressing surprise.
example: ಅಲಾ, ಇಷ್ಟು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮೀನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಿಂದ ತಂದೆ?
example_en: Oh! Where did you bring such a big fish from?

definition: a thick growth of shrubs, underbrush.
example_en: A tiger was hiding in the thick underbrush of the forest.

definition: the region along the sea coast.
example_en: That town is situated in the coastal region.

definition: to bring to the front.
example_en: They brought the new plan to the front in the meeting.

definition: a worker, esp. engaged in menial work, who gets his wages on daily basis.
example_en: They paid the daily-wage workers by evening.

definition: a small quantity.
example_en: Only a small quantity of rice was left for her.

definition: to cause to take (something) out; to get (something) drawn out; to remove from a place.
example_en: He had the stone removed from the path.

definition: a cry expressing fear or pain.
example: ಹಾವು ಕಚ್ಚಲು ಅವನು ಕಿಳಕಿಳ ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿದನು.
example_en: When the snake bit him, he cried out in pain.

definition: a soldier armed with a lance or a member of a regiment armed with lances; a lancer.
example_en: The lancer came riding on a horse.

definition: to include, contain (without oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This plan includes all the villages.

definition: (usu. used in duplicate kiṭikiṭi) an imitative sound (as of a dry bamboo bursting in fire).
example: ಒಣ ಬಿದಿರು ಬೆಂಕಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿಟಿಕಿಟಿ ಎಂದು ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The dry bamboo made a kiti-kiti crackling sound in the fire.

definition: a melodious sound or tone.
example_en: The melodious tone of the birds broke the morning silence.

definition: the river Gangā.

definition: a domestic servant for the service within one's house.
example_en: The domestic servant used to do all the housework.

definition: heat; hotness; high temperature.
example_en: The people were exhausted by the heat of the sun.

definition: the inside, inner surface of anything.
example_en: They cleaned the inner surface of the vessel well.

definition: a man who manufacturers hand-weapons (as swords, daggers etc.).
example_en: The hand-weapon maker made a new sword and sold it.

definition: (dial.) the act of hurrying impatiently or unduly.
example_en: Everyone got confused by his undue hurrying.

definition: a young, male sparrow.
example_en: A young male sparrow flew away from the nest.

definition: a man who habitually takes bribes; a corrupt man.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಲಂಚಗಾಱ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That official was known as a notorious bribe-taker.

definition: a play with pebbles.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ತಿಱಿಕಲ್ಲಾಟ ಎಂದರೆ ಬಹಳ ಇಷ್ಟ.
example_en: The village children love the pebble game very much.

definition: a pair of lockable linked metal rings for securing a prisoneṛs wrists.
example_en: The police put handcuffs on the criminal's wrists.

definition: a big, cylindrical percussion instrument consisting of a hollow cylinder or hemisphere with a membrane stretched tightly over both the ends, played by beating with the hands and a stick.
example_en: The artists played the tavil at the festival.

definition: the act or an instance of killing.
example_en: The killing that took place in the war shocked everyone.

definition: good luck; fortune.
example_en: It was my good fortune that I passed in that examination.

definition: a man to whom property is leased; a tenant or lessee.
example_en: The tenant pays the rent every month.

definition: a light, movable frame made by interweaving coconut-palm leaves, thin bamboo splits, etc. used as a partition.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ತೆಂಗಿನ ಗರಿಯ ನೆರಕೆ ಹಾಕಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They had put up a coconut-leaf partition frame in front of the house.

definition: the sun.
example_en: As soon as the sun rose, the birds chirped.

definition: a taking shelter or refuge.
example_en: The devotee's taking of refuge shows surrender unto God.

definition: a man who or a thing which is afflicted, vexed, tormented.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡ ವ್ಯಥಿತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಸಾಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They rushed the afflicted person injured in the accident to the hospital.

definition: to see; to look at.
example_en: She looked outside from the window.

definition: to talk much and indiscriminately or foolishly.
example_en: The drunken man was talking foolishly and indiscriminately in the street.

definition: any song or hymn of praise; a formal speech or piece of writing praising a person or event; panegyric.
example_en: The devotees sang a hymn of praise to God.

definition: to bow one's head in respect, worship or in courteous greeting.
example_en: The disciple bowed his head in respect before the teacher.

definition: changed, stained or faded colour.
example_en: The old picture had marks of faded colour.

definition: (a plant) to put forth a new branch or branches.
example_en: In the rainy season the plant puts forth new branches.

definition: an useless, vigourless, corpse-like man.
example: ಆ ನರಪೇತನಂತೆ ಮಲಗಿದ್ದವನನ್ನು ಎಬ್ಬಿಸಲು ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one could wake up the man lying there like a useless, corpse-like man.

definition: having seeds.
example: ಈ ಹಣ್ಣು ಬೀಜಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ತಿನ್ನುವಾಗ ಎಚ್ಚರ ಬೇಕು.
example_en: This fruit is seeded, so one must be careful while eating it.

definition: the quality of being vehement; vehemence.
example_en: The vehemence of his speech frightened everyone.

definition: to press together or in between firmly.
example_en: She pressed the clothes tightly into the box.

definition: a definite, tangible form.
example: ಆ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಗೆ ಈಗ ಒಂದು ಸುರಾಳ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದೆ.
example_en: That idea has now taken on a definite, tangible form.

definition: to spoil, render useless; to desolate completely.
example_en: The flood completely desolated the entire village.

definition: a province; a state.
example: ಆ ರಿಯಾಸತ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ನಂತರ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಲೀನವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That princely state merged into India after independence.

definition: a Jaina or Buddhist sage.
example_en: The sage was meditating in the forest.

definition: to throw here and there or strew loosely; to scatter.
example_en: The children scattered the sand while playing.

definition: the act of becoming or fact of being a) faded, withered (as a flower).
example_en: The withering of the flower happened quickly in the sun.

definition: the second marriage of a woman (following the death of her earlier husband); a widow marriage.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಮಱುವಾೞ್ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: For the first time, a widow remarriage took place in that village.

definition: any matter in the form of fine, dry particles; dust.
example: ಗಾಳಿ ಬೀಸಿದಾಗ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ರೇವೆ ಹಾರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: When the wind blew, dust flew up on the road.

definition: the act or an instance of floating; floatage.
example_en: The boat's floating continued with the pull of the water current.

definition: a kind of big fish, Delphinus gangeticus; a variety in porpoise.
example_en: The fisherman caught the porpoise and brought it to the shore.
